title: 1 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 John 3: children of God, sin as lawlessness, the example of Cain, and loving in deed and truth.

questions.text: According to the opening verse, what has the Father's great love given us to be called?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:1 says that the Father has given us such great love that we should be called children of God.

questions.text: What does the letter say will happen when he is revealed?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:2 says that when he is revealed we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

answers.text: We will be hidden away from him forever
We will be like him and will see him just as he is
We will no longer know who he is
We will be turned into his angels

questions.text: What does the letter say sin is?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:4 says that everyone who sins also commits lawlessness, and that sin is lawlessness.

questions.text: Why was he revealed, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:5 says he was revealed to take away our sins, and that no sin is in him.

answers.text: To write down a new law

questions.text: What was the Son of God revealed to do to the works of the devil?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:8 says the Son of God was revealed to this end: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

questions.text: Whom does the letter name as the one who was of the evil one and killed his brother?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:12 names Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother.

questions.text: Why did Cain kill his brother, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:12 says Cain killed him because his own deeds were evil and his brother's were righteous.

answers.text: Because his brother had taken his field
Because his brother had mocked him openly
Because he was greatly afraid of him
Because his deeds were evil and his brother's righteous

questions.text: What does the letter call whoever hates his brother?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:15 says that whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

questions.text: In what way does the letter tell them to love, instead of in word and tongue only?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:18 tells them not to love in word or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

questions.text: By what do we know that he remains in us, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:24 says we know that he remains in us by the Spirit which he gave us.

answers.text: By the signs he showed us
By the dreams he sent us
By the goods he gave us
By the Spirit which he gave us
